consequence.statement: The metric is exposed under the new name lbipam_conflicting_pools; queries, dashboards or alerts using lbipam_conflicting_pools_total need updating to the new name.
consequence.remediation: Update monitoring queries to use lbipam_conflicting_pools.

original.statement: The metric lbipam_conflicting_pools_total has been renamed to lbipam_conflicting_pools.

decision.reason: [ev-2e2ab2d37845] only says, under "Changed Metrics", that `lbipam_conflicting_pools_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_conflicting_pools`. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. The metric is still published under the new name, so behavior-change (review) fits. The proposed statement only says that queries, dashboards or alerts using the old name need updating, which follows from the rename without claiming more. Confidence is low because the evidence does not state the consequence directly. Monitoring that relies on the old name would stop matching, but nothing in the evidence supports calling that a failure kind.
